This issue of the Alamo Threat Brief covers the period 16–22 March 2026 and is dominated by a single strategic driver: the ongoing U.S.–Israeli military campaign against Iran (Operation Epic Fury / Operation Lion's Roar), launched 28 February 2026. The geopolitical and cyber consequences of this conflict are now the most consequential threat environment for Texas critical infrastructure since the Colonial Pipeline attack of 2021. This brief provides Liberty CTI's structured analytical assessment across all four strategic sectors, addresses active Priority Intelligence Requirements, and delivers a 30/60/90-day outlook calibrated to the Texas threat landscape.
